submission.justification: No usable 10 GeV/c pion/kaon separation values were found in the recorded simulation/document results, so no candidate can be certified as satisfying the hard 3.5 sigma performance requirement. Radiator-R2 is excluded because it fails the humidity-ageing hard requirement. Among the candidates with recorded humidity pass status, Radiator-R1 is submitted at the maximum allowed thickness, 6 cm, as a provisional choice intended to maximize photon statistics; however the performance requirement remains unverified and the recommendation should not be treated as validated without rerunning or locating the missing RICH performance simulation outputs.

requirements.requirement: Radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: The submitted option is Radiator-R1, one of the allowed candidate identifiers.

requirements.requirement: Pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma.
requirements.evidence: Recorded separation values for Radiator-R1, R2, and R3 at 1–6 cm are all -1, and performance_values_found = 0; therefore the 3.5 sigma threshold cannot be verified.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: humidity_pass_R1 = 1 in the recorded results. Radiator-R2 failed this requirement with humidity_pass_R2 = 0.
Submitted thickness is 6 cm, which is within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: No simulation performance values were found for any radiator/thickness combination, so the best-performing option cannot be determined from the recorded results. The maximum allowed thickness was chosen only as a provisional photon-statistics maximization choice.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
